query:
-- This query is derived from TPC-H query 14
-- THE TPC SOFTWARE IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT CHARGE FROM TPC.

select
        100.00 * sum(case
                when p_type like 'PROMO%'
                        then l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)
                else 0
        end) / sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as promo_revenue
from
        lineitem,
        part
where
        l_partkey = p_partkey
        and l_shipdate >= date '1995-09-01'
        and l_shipdate < date '1995-10-01'

assignments.expr: (CASE WHEN system."$resolved"."@system@builtin@$like@"("p_type", system."$resolved"."@system@builtin@$literal$@"(system."$resolved"."@system@builtin@from_base64@"('DgAAAFZBUklBQkxFX1dJRFRIAQAAAAEAAAALAAAAAAsAAAAGAAAAUFJPTU8lAA=='))) THEN ("l_extendedprice" * (CAST(DECIMAL '1' AS decimal(10, 0)) - "l_discount")) ELSE CAST(DECIMAL '0.0000' AS decimal(25, 4)) END)
